rxGroup.durability: First two rows fsynced once before parser. Third row actual completion witness written after returned barrier, pending until next strict append/transaction/TX_INTENT/finish; explicit flush before observable presentation. No record omission.
rxGroup.wireAndPublication: Strict TX_INTENT / authority candidate append fsync includes pending completion witness. Owner presentation explicitly flushes if still pending.

admission.fullOriginalTuple: Original immutable input context/source/provenance/axes/pointers/action/uptime/elapsed/observation; malformed values bounded using original invalidInput encoding.
admission.expiry: Durable rejection then explicit CONTROL_REVOKED INPUT_ADMISSION_EXPIRED; finite original safety path only; new fresh consent required; never renew oldlease or rebind newerUI to oldinput.
admission.generic: Durable full rejection then INVALID_INPUT revoke and original fatal exception. Storage failures propagate, never safe-expiry.
admission.receiver: Validate exact shapes, original tuple/domain/sequence/temporal predicates, priorlease, immediate causal revocation. No silent skip.
